title: Reporting upon request on COVID-19 control measures dispensed under a standing order
rule_summary: A pharmacist who dispenses a COVID-19 control measure in accordance with a standing order issued under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 19E(b) shall, upon request, report to the department on the doses, tests or devices dispensed. Reports shall be confidential and shall not constitute a public record under clause Twenty-sixth of section 7 of chapter 4. The department shall publish an annual report that includes aggregate information about the dispensing of COVID-19 control measures in the commonwealth.
exam_relevance: Tests that the pharmacist's report is made upon request rather than on an annual cycle, that it covers the doses, tests or devices dispensed, that the reports are confidential and not public records, and that the department publishes a separate aggregate annual report.
common_confusions: Putting the pharmacist's COVID-19 report on an annual cycle.
Limiting the report to COVID-19 drugs when it covers the doses, tests or devices dispensed.
Attributing to this subsection the sentence barring identification of an individual patient that appears in s. 19A(e) and s. 19B(d).
verification_notes: Read in the current text of M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 19E on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-14.
